A 3 bedroom detached bungalow (originally 4 bedroom) residence extending to c. 107 sq.m. sitting on a gorgeous site of c. 0.3 acre.

This bungalow is well proportioned and lay out and could be easily upgraded and extended.

This property was originally a 4 bedroom home and with little work the 4th bedroom could be reinstated.

It sits on a lovely site with gorgeous gardens to the front, enjoys a wide side access and offer a spacious landscaped and well maintained rear garden.

Ideally positioned in the peaceful countryside setting of Ladyrath, Wilkinstown, this property enjoys the perfect balance of rural tranquillity and convenience.

The heritage village of Slane is just 10km away, offering cafés, restaurants, and everyday amenities, while Navan is only 15km away.

Wilkinstown has so much to offer with the newly upgraded Community Centre, excellent school, the beautiful Greenway stretching to Navan and Kingscourt, the every day convenience of Doughtys Mace which sits beside Park Beo.

Drogheda and the M1 motorway can be reached in approximately 25 minutes, providing easy access to Dublin and the east coast.

The nearby N2/M2 road network ensures excellent commuter connectivity, with Dublin Airport less than an hour's drive away.

Accommodation includes Entrance Hall, Lounge, Kitchen / Dining, Back Hall / Utility, 3 Bedrooms (Originally 4 Bedrooms) and Shower Room.
